name: Windows Settings Manager Lite
description:
Windows Settings Manager Lite gives you the everyday Windows controls that are most useful on a physical Stream Deck: control your PC without opening Windows Settings or leaving what you are doing.

Lite includes six focused actions: Lock PC, Sleep, live Power Plan, Keep Awake, Previous Desktop, and Next Desktop. It is intentionally small, useful on its own, and easy to understand at a glance.

The stateful controls read Windows instead of assuming the last PackRat command is still active. Keep Awake clearly shows STAY AWAKE or SLEEP NORMAL, Power Plan shows the active plan, and virtual desktop navigation verifies the resulting Windows desktop state where Windows exposes it.

If you want the complete Windows control surface, Windows Settings Manager Pro expands the same use case with Hibernate, protected Restart and Shutdown, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Light/Dark theme, New/Close/Current Desktop, and additional advanced Windows controls.

No coordinate clicking, hidden mouse movement, or fake state. If Windows cannot expose a capability reliably, PackRat fails closed instead of pretending.

Includes editable profiles for Stream Deck, Stream Deck Mini, Stream Deck XL, Stream Deck +, Stream Deck Neo, Galleon 100 SD, and Stream Deck + XL.

Requires Windows and Stream Deck 7.3 or later.

Part of the PackRat ecosystem.
release_notes:
- Six focused everyday Windows controls: Lock, Sleep, Power Plan, Keep Awake, Previous Desktop, and Next Desktop.
- Live Windows state for the controls that expose it.
- Verified virtual desktop navigation instead of blind hotkey success.
- Editable profiles for seven current Stream Deck device families.
